row.scim_price_text: Included in DPS (annual commit, usage-based rate card); no SCIM upcharge
row.team_price_text: Infrastructure Monitoring: $29/mo per host (rate card, drawn from annual commit)
row.evidence: Dynatrace's pricing FAQ says a Dynatrace Platform Subscription "gives you access to all platform capabilities that are generally available", with SSO listed as included and "no per-seat fees, no user tiers"; the SCIM docs describe SCIM 2.0 for Dynatrace SaaS with no plan restriction.
row.notes: Changed from gated to free. Dynatrace sells one licensing model, the Dynatrace Platform Subscription (minimum annual spend commit drawn down at a public rate card), which includes every generally available capability, unlimited seats and SSO; there are no user tiers. The SCIM docs name no plan or edition gate. June's 'requires Enterprise contract' and 'median ACV ~$183K' had no first-party source and were dropped. Prices are per host or per GiB, so per-user fields are null. SCIM is documented for Okta (SCIM 2.0 test apps) and Entra ID (non-gallery app); the gallery/OIN apps are SSO only. Domain ownership verification is required before SCIM. User and group management also available through the Account Management API (OAuth client scopes).

plans.name: Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS)
plans.price_text: Minimum annual spend commit consumed at rate card, e.g. Foundation & Discovery $7/mo per host, Infrastructure Monitoring $29/mo per host, Full-Stack Monitoring $58/mo per 8 GiB host
plans.notes: Single subscription; capabilities are not tiered. Commit amount is not published.

auth.token_source: Account Management > Identity & access management > SCIM configuration > Generate token
auth.notes: Token shown once; up to 10 SCIM tokens per account.

deprovision.notes: Docs: a user disabled or removed in the IdP is disabled in Dynatrace. Seats are unlimited under DPS, so seat freeing is moot.

attributes.notes: userName is the email and must be persistent; email changes via SCIM are ignored. Entra mapping also sends displayName. FAQ: additional fields such as group description cannot be set during provisioning.

roles.how: Permissions to SCIM groups must be assigned manually in Dynatrace or via the Account Management API.

limitations.text: Only users whose email domains have been verified for ownership can be synchronized.
Email address changes via SCIM are ignored; userName must be persistent.
SCIM-type groups cannot be removed or modified through Account Management.
SCIM is for Dynatrace SaaS; per-IdP guides exist only for Azure (Entra ID) and Okta.
Default account limit of 10,000 users (adjustable) and 10 SCIM tokens (not adjustable).

auth.notes: OAuth clients created in Account Management > Identity & access management > OAuth clients; Bearer token in Authorization header.

capabilities.notes: Roles are permissions assigned to groups via the Permission management API.

rate_limits.text: OAuth token requests are throttled per source IP and per OAuth client id; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.

limitations.text: No documented update or disable endpoint for users in the User management API (list, create, delete, group membership only).

okta.notes: OIN 'Dynatrace' app marks SAML and SWA only (read from page markup). Dynatrace's Okta guide provisions through Okta's SCIM 2.0 test apps or by adding SCIM to the SSO app.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO with JIT; Dynatrace's Azure SCIM guide uses a non-gallery enterprise app.

onelogin.notes: Not checked (OneLogin catalogue bot-blocked); Dynatrace has no OneLogin SCIM guide.
